text:
Lena: Quick Q — planning to kick off a "Welcome Buddy" program the week of 2025-05-12. Objectives: help new hires ramp faster, give managers an informal buddy option, and recognize great buddies with small spot awards.
Tom: Love it. How many buddies do we need? Any role restrictions?
Lena: Targeting all new hires for next quarter (~40). Open to any tenured IC or PM with >6 months tenure. Ops support wanted for pairing and comms.
Sofia: I can take intake/chat form + pairing spreadsheet. Will we auto-match by team or interest?
Lena: Prefer primary team match first, interest as fallback. Sofia — can you prototype a simple Google Form and sheet this week?
Sofia: Yep, will drop link by Thu.
Raj: For recognition — propose 2x $50 spot awards and a "Buddy of the Month" shoutout in All-Hands. Is budget approved?
Kara: Confirmed with finance: micro-spot budget available. Need PO coding: "Culture-Spot". I'll DM the steps.
Lena: Awesome. Also want a launch drop-in lunch (30 min) on Mon 12th 12pm PT for paired buddies. Volunteer hosts?
Tom: I can host the west-coast slot. Sofia can host the east-coast friendly slot.
Sofia: +1. I'll create calendar invites with timezone-friendly blocks.
people-ops-bot: Reminder: onboarding doc updated — "Welcome Buddy guide" now lives in /handbook/onboarding. Link posted.
Lena: Final ask — can each host submit one short prompt for the kickoff (icebreaker q) and one suggested best practice by Fri? We'll compile.
Tom: Will do.
Raj: I'll collect nomination criteria for Buddy of the Month and share a one-pager by Friday.
Lena: Thanks all — will follow up with a checklist and timeline. :sparkles:
